neighbours.label: The closing piece of a multi-token proper name (Kilimanj|aro, Okav|ango, Thessalon|iki) or the final word of a multi-word proper name (Secret Service, Supreme Court, Salvation Army)
fire: Climbers often take a week to reach the top of Kilimanjaro.
Hippos gather in the channels of the Okavango Delta each dry season.
The port of Thessaloniki handles most of the region's trade.
Agents from the Secret Service cleared the hall before the speech.
The case went all the way to the Supreme Court last spring.
Volunteers from the Salvation Army served soup to the crowd.
Her grandmother was born in Bratislava before the war.
The ferry from Dar es Salaam reaches Zanzibar in two hours.
quiet: The patient was treated for thrombocytopenia after the transfusion.
Doctors found hepatosplenomegaly on the scan.
The plan was counterproductive from the start.
Her reaction was unenthusiastic at best.
He moved to Berlin and then to Madrid for work.
The shop in Chicago closed after thirty years.
The committee issued a statement about the new requirements.
The trees turn yellow in the park every October.

predictions: Names split into several tokens reach 0.3-0.9 on their last piece and institution names on their last word. Rare common words split the same way (thrombocytopenia, hepatosplenomegaly, counterproductive) and single-token place names (Berlin, Madrid, Chicago) stay under 0.05.
short: last piece of a proper name
notes: Probe: National Citizen Service 0.864 (' Service'), Grand Cayman 0.763 ('man'), Democratic Republic 0.613 (' Republic'), Candomblé 0.574 ('é'), Ngorongoro 0.481 ('oro'), Korsakoff 0.310 (peak 'ak', not the last piece); rhabdomyolysis 0.020, saguaro 0.024, London 0.014, settlements 0.012. Card: ' Republic' x6, 'oro', 'man', 'ina', 'ia', ' Service', ' Force' among the top peaks (max 7.75, layer 7). The distinction tested is name versus common word, both split; the - pole peaks on 'field', 'more', ' Monroe', 'ham'.
